name: Dockhand
description: Modern Docker management UI for real-time container control, visual Compose stack orchestration, Git stack deployments, interactive terminal and logs, container file browsing, vulnerability scanning, and multi-environment management via socket or Hawser.
short_desc: Modern Docker management UI with Compose stacks, terminal, logs, and PostgreSQL backend
author: Finsys

form_fields.label: POSTGRES_USER
form_fields.hint: PostgreSQL username initialized on first startup and used by Dockhand in DATABASE_URL.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or '_' and use only letters, numbers, '_' or '-'.

form_fields.label: POSTGRES_DB
form_fields.hint: PostgreSQL database name used by Dockhand. Default: dockhand.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or '_' and use only letters, numbers, '_' or '-'.

form_fields.label: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Automatically generated random hex password for PostgreSQL, shared cleanly with Dockhand via DATABASE_URL.

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name for Dockhand. Default: dockhand (if left blank, falls back to dockhand).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: postgres container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name for the PostgreSQL service. Default: dockhand-postgres (if left blank, falls back to dockhand-postgres).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').
